markdown_content: ## Clo 2025.1 Library and Connect Tab Overview This section explains the new features and user interface improvements in the Clo 2025.1 library, focusing on the Connect tab. It covers asset management, filtering options, and user interaction features such as liking and bookmarking assets. The updated Clo 2025.1 library includes a dedicated **Connect tab** that centralizes access to all Connect assets available on the website. Users can easily navigate this tab to manage various asset types such as garments, avatars, and fabrics. The interface supports robust filtering options, allowing users to sort assets by categories like free, curated PRIC, and personal collections. For example, users can filter to see only garments or avatars and even narrow down further within those categories. The Connect tab also allows users to view their purchase history, although in the demonstrated case no purchases had been made yet. Additional features include viewing liked items and bookmarked assets, which helps in organizing preferred content efficiently. ## Asset Interaction and Management This section details how users can interact with individual assets within the Clo 2025.1 Connect tab, including features for liking, bookmarking, and viewing detailed information. When selecting an asset, such as a fabric or avatar, users can access detailed information panels. Within these panels, they can **like** or **bookmark** assets for easy retrieval later. This functionality enables a personalized workflow, where users can curate their favorite assets in their "likes" or "board" sections. For instance, a user might browse fabrics, like several they prefer, and bookmark others they want to save for future projects. The same applies to avatars, where users can filter by specific features like hair and save preferred options. These interaction tools streamline asset management and enhance the overall user experience in Clo 2025.1. --- This document captures the key features and user workflows introduced in Clo 2025.1 related to the library and Connect tab, preserving all functional details necessary for understanding and utilizing the updated platform effectively.
